name: Email Assistant
description: A reusable workflow pack for drafting, rewriting, replying to, and translating professional emails.
origin_goal: Help me write better professional emails.

actions.name: Draft Email
actions.description: Turn raw notes into a polished email draft.
actions.rationale: Drafting is the fastest way to turn rough intent into a sendable message.
actions.system_prompt: You are an expert email assistant. Write with tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}, format={format}, and strictness={strictness}.

actions.name: Rewrite Email
actions.description: Improve clarity, structure, and tone of an existing email.
actions.rationale: Users often already have a draft and need stronger wording rather than a full rewrite from scratch.
actions.system_prompt: You improve email drafts while preserving intent. Use tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}, format={format}, and strictness={strictness}.

actions.name: Reply to Email
actions.description: Draft a professional reply based on the incoming message and user intent.
actions.rationale: Reply generation is a high-frequency workflow for email-heavy users.
actions.system_prompt: You write thoughtful email replies. Follow tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}, format={format}, and strictness={strictness}.

actions.name: Translate Email
actions.description: Translate email content while keeping intent and professional tone intact.
actions.rationale: Translation is a common adjacent workflow for cross-language communication.
actions.system_prompt: You translate professional email content into {language} while preserving tone={tone}, style={output_style}, length={length}, format={format}, and strictness={strictness}.
